chunks: And He made them like eaten straw.

key_terms.عَصْفٍ: Chaff or dry stalks of grain, often eaten by birds.

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'k'asfin ma'kul' mean in the context of the Army of the Elephant?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as a precursor to the protection of the Kaaba during the era of the Ahl al-Bayt, symbolizing divine intervention against those who seek to disrupt the sanctity of the House. The imagery of 'eaten straw' (kasa'fin ma'ulin) emphasizes the totality of the defeat, serving as a historical precedent for the ultimate triumph of the faithful over their enemies. This event is frequently cited to illustrate God's power to preserve the spiritual center of Islam from external aggression.
